lines: Dil lagi meri koi kya jaane
couplets.en: Who could know what stirs in my heart?
The heart alone knows, or the one who stole it.
What would those who nurse grudges know of this melody?
What would the proud know of pleading?
Ask those who drink where the pleasure of wine lies.
What would the virtuous know of such pleasure?
What would the virtuous know of such pleasure?

lines: Jin ko apni khabar nahin ab tak
couplets.en: Some have yet to know their own hearts.

lines: Woh mere dil ka raaz kya jaanen
couplets.en: How could they know the secret of mine?

lines: Dil lagi meri koi kya jaane
couplets.en: Who could know what stirs in my heart?

lines: Jo guzarte hain Daagh par sadme
couplets.en: Think of the sorrows that pass through Daagh.
What would you know of them, gracious one?

couplets.en: Who could know what stirs in my heart?
